theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the headline narrative with a trend tag, highest-tier durability (0.84), full breadth (1.0), and is trend-gate eligible. Crowding_z 1.46 signals a cap on how much more room this run has, but per guardrails that is a size-down caution, not a fade.
